METEOR was used for algorithm validation (sentence similarity matching) not for evaluation of generated outputs, so removed from metrics

guideline: The algorithm achieves an average accuracy of 94% in exactly identifying revised sentences and 93% in exactly identifying justifications.

changes_made.explanation: Algorithm accuracy metrics refer to automated extraction of LLM outputs, not human evaluation of the generated content itself

overall_notes: The paper focuses on text revision as an NLG task using multiple LLMs. It uses automated analysis (logistic regression, theme analysis) but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluations. Extraction was generally accurate but included some internal validation metrics incorrectly categorized as evaluation metrics.
